=== /home/rasp/miniproj_epan/hailo-rpi5-examples/run_detection_fps.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eo pipefail

APP_DIR="/home/rasp/miniproj_epan/hailo-rpi5-examples"
INTERNET_CHECK_HOST="8.8.8.8"     # Google DNS — fast ping target
RETRY_INTERVAL=5                   # seconds between retries

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ensure DISPLAY is set for GTK UI (kiosk mode).
# When launched from a desktop autostart entry, DISPLAY is normally inherited.
# When launched from a systemd user service or cron, it may be missing.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:0}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Camera URL — single source of truth is .env, same as the Python side.
# We do NOT source .env: it holds secrets (API keys, AWS creds) and is known to
# contain lines python-dotenv cannot parse, which would abort us under `set -e`.
# Read the one key we need instead.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
env_get() {
    sed -n -E "s/^[[:space:]]*$1[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p" "$APP_DIR/.env" 2>/dev/null \
        | tail -1 | tr -d '"'\''\r' | sed -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//'
}

# Precedence mirrors config/settings.py: RTSP_URL, then CAMERA_SOURCE.
CAMERA_URL="${RTSP_URL:-$(env_get RTSP_URL)}"
[[ -n "$CAMERA_URL" ]] || CAMERA_URL="${CAMERA_SOURCE:-$(env_get CAMERA_SOURCE)}"
if [[ -z "$CAMERA_URL" ]]; then
    log "ERROR: no RTSP_URL or CAMERA_SOURCE set in environment or $APP_DIR/.env"
    exit 1
fi
log "Camera URL: $CAMERA_URL"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Phase 1 — wait for internet
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "Waiting for internet connectivity..."
until ping -c 1 -W 3 "$INTERNET_CHECK_HOST" &>/dev/null; do
    log "  No internet. Retrying in ${RETRY_INTERVAL}s..."
    sleep "$RETRY_INTERVAL"
done
log "Internet connected."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Phase 2 — wait for RTSP camera
# Extracts host and port from the RTSP URL, then does a TCP probe.
# ffprobe would be more accurate but requires the full stack; nc is enough
# to confirm the camera is reachable and accepting connections.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parse host/port from rtsp://host[:port]/...
CAMERA_HOST=$(echo "$CAMERA_URL" | sed -E 's|rtsp://([^/:]+).*|\1|')
CAMERA_PORT=$(echo "$CAMERA_URL" | sed -E 's|rtsp://[^/:]+:([0-9]+).*|\1|')
# Default RTSP port if none specified in URL
[[ "$CAMERA_PORT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || CAMERA_PORT=554

log "Waiting for camera at ${CAMERA_HOST}:${CAMERA_PORT}..."
CAM_ATTEMPTS=0
until nc -z -w 3 "$CAMERA_HOST" "$CAMERA_PORT" &>/dev/null; do
    CAM_ATTEMPTS=$((CAM_ATTEMPTS + 1))
    # Every ~12 failures (1 min) dump our own addressing next to the target, so a
    # subnet mismatch is obvious in the log instead of an endless silent retry.
    if (( CAM_ATTEMPTS % 12 == 1 )); then
        log "  Camera not reachable (attempt ${CAM_ATTEMPTS}). Target ${CAMERA_HOST}:${CAMERA_PORT}; this host: $(ip -4 -o addr show scope global | awk '{print $2"="$4}' | paste -sd' ')"
    else
        log "  Camera not reachable. Retrying in ${RETRY_INTERVAL}s..."
    fi
    # After a minute of failure, hunt for the camera across subnets once. This is
    # what turns a silent multi-hour stall into a one-line diagnosis. Read-only,
    # and guarded so it can never abort the launch.
    if (( CAM_ATTEMPTS == 12 )) && [[ -x "$APP_DIR/utils/find_camera.sh" ]]; then
        log "  --- camera locator ---"
        while IFS= read -r line; do log "    $line"; done \
            < <("$APP_DIR/utils/find_camera.sh" 2>&1 || true)
        log "  --- end locator ---"
    fi
    sleep "$RETRY_INTERVAL"
done
log "Camera reachable."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Phase 3 — wait for vehicle to start moving (GPS speed gate)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cd "$APP_DIR"
source "$APP_DIR/setup_env.sh"

log "Waiting for vehicle speed >= ${MIN_SPEED_KMH:-3} km/h (GPS)..."
python "$APP_DIR/utils/wait_for_speed.py"
log "Vehicle moving. Starting pipeline."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Phase 4 — short stabilisation delay then launch
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "Starting in 7 seconds..."
sleep 7

log "Launching detection pipeline."

# Capture stdout/stderr and GStreamer warnings to disk so post-mortem
# debugging is possible (the Python edge_inference logger does NOT see
# print(), GStreamer messages, ffmpeg recorder stderr, or rtspsrc reconnects).
RUNTIME_LOG_DIR="$APP_DIR/logs"
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_LOG_DIR"
RUN_TS="$(date '+%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')"
RUNTIME_LOG="$RUNTIME_LOG_DIR/runtime_${RUN_TS}.log"
GST_LOG="$RUNTIME_LOG_DIR/gst_${RUN_TS}.log"
export GST_DEBUG="${GST_DEBUG:-2}"          # 2 = WARNING only; near-zero overhead
export GST_DEBUG_FILE="$GST_LOG"
export GST_DEBUG_NO_COLOR=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
log "Runtime log: $RUNTIME_LOG"
log "GStreamer log: $GST_LOG (GST_DEBUG=$GST_DEBUG)"

exec python basic_pipelines/detection.py \
    --input "$CAMERA_URL" \
    --hef-path "$APP_DIR/yolov11n_dataset9-9.hef" \
    --labels-json "$APP_DIR/labels.json" \
    --show-fps \
    >>"$RUNTIME_LOG" 2>&1

"""Wait for vehicle to reach minimum GPS speed before exiting.

Standalone script called from run_detection_fps.sh to gate pipeline startup
until the vehicle is actually moving.

Env vars:
    GPS_ENABLED, GPS_PORT, GPS_BAUD, GPS_FIX_MAX_AGE_SEC — passed through to GPSReader
    MIN_SPEED_KMH  — minimum speed to consider "moving" (default: 3.0)
    GPS_SPEED_GATE_TIMEOUT_SEC — max wait for GPS hardware/fix before giving up (default: 120)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import os
import sys
import time

# Ensure project root is on sys.path so `utils.gps` can be imported
# when this script is invoked directly from the repo root.
_PROJECT_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
if _PROJECT_ROOT not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _PROJECT_ROOT)

from utils.gps import create_gps_reader, _parse_float  # noqa: E402

POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 2.0


def main() -> int:
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO,
        format="[%(asctime)s] %(message)s",
        datefmt="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S",
    )
    logger = logging.getLogger("wait_for_speed")

    min_speed = _parse_float(os.getenv("MIN_SPEED_KMH"), 3.0)

    # Force GPS_ENABLED so we can create a reader even if .env isn't loaded yet
    os.environ.setdefault("GPS_ENABLED", "1")

    gps_timeout = _parse_float(os.getenv("GPS_SPEED_GATE_TIMEOUT_SEC"), 120.0)
    deadline = time.time() + gps_timeout

    # Retry GPS reader creation until success or timeout
    reader = None
    while reader is None:
        reader = create_gps_reader(logger)
        if reader is not None:
            break
        if time.time() >= deadline:
            logger.warning(
                "GPS unavailable after %.0fs — skipping speed gate.", gps_timeout,
            )
            return 0
        logger.info("  GPS not ready, retrying in %.0fs...", POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
        time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)

    try:
        # Phase A: wait for a valid GPS fix (timeout applies here)
        logger.info("Waiting for valid GPS fix (timeout: %.0fs) ...", gps_timeout)
        got_fix = False
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if reader.get_speed() is not None:
                got_fix = True
                break
            logger.info("  No valid GPS fix yet — %.0fs remaining",
                         deadline - time.time())
            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)

        if not got_fix:
            logger.warning(
                "No GPS fix after %.0fs — skipping speed gate.", gps_timeout,
            )
            return 0

        # Phase B: GPS works — wait indefinitely for vehicle to move
        # Poll every 2s for responsiveness, but only log every 10s while stationary.
        LOG_INTERVAL_SEC = 10.0
        logger.info("GPS fix acquired. Waiting for speed >= %.1f km/h ...", min_speed)
        last_log = 0.0
        while True:
            speed = reader.get_speed()
            if speed is not None and speed >= min_speed:
                logger.info("Vehicle moving at %.1f km/h — proceeding.", speed)
                return 0
            now = time.time()
            if now - last_log >= LOG_INTERVAL_SEC:
                if speed is not None:
                    logger.info("  Speed: %.1f km/h (below %.1f threshold)",
                                speed, min_speed)
                else:
                    logger.info("  Waiting for GPS fix...")
                last_log = now
            time.sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_SEC)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logger.info("Interrupted.")
        return 130
    finally:
        reader.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

=== /etc/systemd/system/hailo-detection.service ===
[Unit]
Description=Hailo RTSP detection (show FPS)
Wants=network-online.target hailort.service
After=network-online.target hailort.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=rasp
WorkingDirectory=/home/rasp/miniproj_epan/hailo-rpi5-examples
ExecStart=/bin/bash /home/rasp/miniproj_epan/hailo-rpi5-examples/run_detection_fps.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
